title: Power Rankings: Pistons stay in the No. 1 spot
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Week 9
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Winning in Boston is only one justification for the Pistons' claim to the No. 1 spot. For all you margin-of-victory devotees, here's No. 2: Detroit is on a 15-2 run and has racked up 13 double-digit wins in that stretch.
rankings.summaryText: Winning in Boston is only one justification for the Pistons' claim to the No. 1 spot. For all you margin-of-victory devotees, here's No. 2: Detroit is on a 15-2 run and has racked up 13 double-digit wins in that stretch.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Sports Guy claims that they're three plays away from being the first 29-0 team in history. Whether or not you buy that, give it up to the Celts for their road exploits after all that noise about their soft early schedule.

rankings.summaryHtml: It probably won't have any effect, but this should temper some of the local panic that follows every Suns defeat: Phoenix was forced to play 19 of its first 31 games on the road. Try to see the sunny side, people.
